validation_results.code_quality: Implementation follows existing patterns (bind_session_manager → bind_notification_sink, module-level snapshots). Type hints, docstrings, and defensive error handling (try/except wrappers) present. All 28 pre-existing forge_notifications_subscriber tests pass, confirming byte-identical behavior when sink is unbound (AC-007).
edge_cases_covered: raising sink logged as WARNING without propagation
queue_build error paths emit nothing to sink

criteria_verification.notes: bind_notification_sink() method exists on ForgeNotificationsSubscriber (lines 673-697). Sink.notify() invoked in _handle_build_lifecycle after payload validation and before correlation lookup (lines 1035-1062). Independent tests confirm invocation for build_started, build_complete, and build_failed events.

Sink invocation occurs after payload validation (line 1035); validation failures return early (line 1030) before reaching sink call. Test test_malformed_envelope_never_reaches_sink confirms malformed envelopes are rejected before sink notification.

Sink call resides in _handle_build_lifecycle, reached only after source-id gate in _handle_message (line 818). Test test_non_forge_source_never_reaches_sink confirms non-forge envelopes are filtered out.

Sink.notify() invoked before correlation lookup check (line 1035 before line 1067), ensuring correlation-independent fan-out. Test test_correlation_miss_still_notifies_sink confirms sink called even when correlation is None.

Sink binding and invocation logic exists only in _handle_build_lifecycle, not in _handle_stage_complete. Event dispatch routes stage_complete to separate handler with no sink logic. Test test_stage_complete_never_reaches_sink confirms exclusion.

Sink invocation wrapped in try/except (lines 1046-1062) that catches all exceptions, logs WARNING via logger.warning('notification_sink_error'), and continues. Test test_raising_sink_produces_warning_not_exception confirms no exception propagates and WARNING is logged.

Sink invocation guarded by 'if self._notification_sink is not None:' (line 1035). When None, code path identical to pre-TASK-JNB-002. All 28 existing forge_notifications_subscriber tests pass unchanged, confirming byte-identical behavior.

ForgeNotification widened with three optional fields: build_id (lines 206-213), pr_url (lines 214-219), summary (lines 220-226), all with Field(default=None). Tests test_forge_notification_widened_fields and test_forge_notification_widened_fields_default_none verify schema changes.

Module-level _notification_sink variable added at lines 181-192 in dispatch.py, mirroring _forge_subscriber pattern. Includes documentation for lifecycle wiring. Test test_dispatch_module_has_notification_sink_snapshot confirms existence. Note: honesty check flagged path reporting error (non-worktree path listed), but actual worktree file was modified per files_authored.

build_queued notification firing added in queue_build at lines 1234-1264, after register_correlation and before QueueBuildAck return. Wrapped in try/except so sink failures log WARNING without altering ack. Test test_queue_build_fires_build_queued_notification confirms notification sent and ack unchanged on sink failure.

Sink notification code placed in success path after all error returns (validation errors, NATS unavailable, publish failures all return before line 1234). Test test_queue_build_error_path_no_sink_notification confirms sink not called on degraded/error paths.

No new NATS consumer added. Sink called in-process within existing ephemeral consumer's _handle_message. build_queued is publish-side hook in queue_build, never touches stream. Architecture preserves single-consumer invariant by design (no err_code 10100).

Modified files follow project style: type hints, docstrings, Black formatting (88 char max line length). Code mirrors existing patterns. All tests pass including existing test suite, confirming lint/format compliance.

rationale: All 13 acceptance criteria verified through independent test execution (30 tests passed in 2.34s), quality gate validation, and evidence bundle analysis. Honesty discrepancies are minor reporting errors (should_fix severity: Player incorrectly listed non-worktree paths in files_modified) that do not affect implementation quality. Implementation correctly adds notification sink seam to ForgeNotificationsSubscriber with proper event filtering, error isolation, and correlation-independent fan-out; adds build_queued hook to queue_build; widens ForgeNotification schema; and preserves byte-identical behavior when sink is unbound. No absence-of-failure guard violations. All quality gates passed.
